# Dispatch label requirements
Document ID: DISPATCH-POLICY

## 1 Destination
Every parcel must state its destination.

## 2 Return address
Every parcel must have a return address. Add the sender's return address if it is missing.

## 3 Tracking
Every parcel must have a readable tracking barcode. Reprint an unreadable barcode before dispatch.

## 4 Release
Do not dispatch a parcel until all label requirements are met.
